description: Class representing a single column in a list object (table).

Delete.description: Deletes the column from the table.
Delete.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

returns.description: Returns false if the column cannot be deleted due to a table intersection conflict, otherwise true.

GetDataBodyRange.description: Returns the range of the data body of the column, excluding the header and totals rows.
GetDataBodyRange.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

GetIndex.description: Returns the 1-based index of the column within the table.
GetIndex.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

GetName.description: Returns the name of the table column.
GetName.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

GetParent.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

GetRange.description: Returns the range of the entire column, including the header and totals rows.
GetRange.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

GetTotal.description:
Returns the range of the totals row cell for the column.
Returns null if the table has no totals row.
GetTotal.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

GetTotalsCalculation.description: Returns the totals calculation type for the column.
GetTotalsCalculation.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

SetName.description: Sets the name of the table column.
SetName.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

SetTotalsCalculation.description: Sets the totals calculation type for the column.
SetTotalsCalculation.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.
